title: Peter Obi meets Seriake Dickson ahead of NDC Campaign Council inauguration
summary: NDC National Leader Henry Seriake Dickson received Presidential Candidate Peter Obi and other senior leaders including Babachir Lawal and National Chairman Moses Cleopas upon returning from an overseas trip. The fruitful discussions covered party readiness for the 2027 elections and preparations for the National Campaign Council inauguration on Monday 26 October. All leaders and candidates are aligned. Pair this national unity with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan)’s ongoing mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon.

title: 85 days to election: NDC Campaign Council inauguration on Monday 26 October — Oluwadara Kehinde ready
summary: With 85 days until the 16 January 2027 election, the NDC is set to unveil and inaugurate the Obi-Kwankwaso Presidential Campaign Council on Monday, 26 October. While the national ticket prepares for full campaign mode, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues consistent ward-level engagement across Yewa North and Imeko-Afon. Supporters are encouraged to amplify both the national momentum and the local people-centred agenda.

title: Peter Obi in London: Meetings with British officials and Nigerian diaspora on rebuilding Nigeria
summary: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi arrived in London from Basel on 21 October and held a series of meetings with British government officials and Nigerian diaspora stakeholders, including one organised by the COPDEM Chief and NDC Director of Diaspora Affairs. Discussions focused on collective responsibility to free Nigeria from bad leadership, corruption and lack of accountability so every citizen can access healthcare, education and decent jobs. “A New Nigeria is Possible.” Pair this national energy with Oluwadara Kehinde’s ongoing ward work in Yewa North/Imeko-Afon.

title: NDC to hold fresh congresses to replace candidates who defected to APC
summary: NDC National Publicity Secretary Osa Director announced that the party will immediately conduct fresh congresses under the Electoral Act 2026 to elect credible replacements for candidates who defected to the APC after alleged inducements. The party described the defections as lacking commitment and reassured members that preparations for the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket and all candidates continue. Local work in Yewa North/Imeko-Afon with Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) remains strong.

title: NDC postpones Obi-Kwankwaso Presidential Campaign Council inauguration to 26 October
summary: The NDC has shifted the unveiling and inauguration of its National Campaign Council from 20 October to 26 October because of Peter Obi’s important overseas engagement. The party apologises for any inconvenience and urges members and supporters to stay focused on securing victory for the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket and all NDC candidates, including Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) in Yewa North/Imeko-Afon.

title: Peter Obi at Paris ECFR roundtable: Move from consumption to production with competent leadership
summary: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi took part in a roundtable discussion at the European Council on Foreign Relations office in Paris. Talks covered development cooperation, bilateral partnerships, and the need for accountable leadership that invests in people, education, healthcare and strong institutions. “A New Nigeria is Possible.” Pair this national vision with Oluwadara Kehinde’s people-centred agenda at home.

title: Peter Obi engages Nigerians in Manchester and Birmingham: Building a New Nigeria is our collective responsibility
summary: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi met diaspora Nigerians in Manchester and Birmingham. Discussions centered on tackling corruption, electing leaders with capacity, character, compassion and commitment, and moving Nigeria from consumption to production. A New Nigeria is Possible. Pair national energy with Oluwadara Kehinde’s local work in Yewa North/Imeko-Afon.

title: World Food Day 2026: Innovate today, nourish tomorrow — Oluwadara Kehinde prioritises agriculture
summary: On World Food Day (theme: Innovate Today, Nourish Tomorrow), Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan), NDC candidate for Yewa North/Imeko-Afon, renews his call for modern farming practices, value addition, reduced post-harvest losses and better opportunities for grassroots farmers so communities can feed themselves and thrive.
